headline: Datacenter demand lifts growth; outlook raised again
summary_short: Net sales grew 25% (organic +11%, M&A +13%) and adjusted EPS rose 14% to $5.91, with adjusted operating margin up 160bp to 25.5%. Hubbell raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $20.40-$20.60.
summary_long: Electrical Solutions sales rose 51% to $845M, with organic growth of 22% led by datacenter markets and acquisitions adding 29%. Utility Solutions sales rose 9% to $1,028M, up about 5% organically. Free cash flow was $280M versus $254M. Management expects 2026 sales growth of 18-19% including 10-11% organic, GAAP diluted EPS of $17.30-$17.50, and free cash flow conversion near 90% of adjusted net income.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS excludes $0.89 of acquisition-related amortization and $0.08 of transaction, integration and separation costs. Free cash flow delta computed from $280M vs $254M stated in the release. Prior-year GAAP EPS was not in the portion read.

drivers.explanation: Organic growth of 11% plus 13% from acquisitions including NSI; Electrical Solutions organic growth above 20% was led by datacenter markets and capacity expansion.
Volume growth, acquisitions, favorable price realization, productivity and a net tariff benefit, partly offset by cost inflation and raw material costs.
CEO says orders and end-market demand stayed strong, building backlog, and the outlook raise is primarily driven by stronger Electrical Solutions growth.
